agent.summary: Added the post-HELLO configuration frames to xs-wire: IO, COMPRESS, XATTR, ACL, CHOWN, SPARSE, LINKDEST, RELATIVE, FILES_CONFIG/DATA/END, FILTER, DELETE, PRUNE and OUTPUT. Encoding matches run_client byte for byte, decoding checks framing, negotiated features and hostile-peer bounds. Unit byte tests and a C++ server interop test pass, along with clippy and fmt.
agent.diagnosis: Read remote.cpp's run_client (around 2892) and run_server (around 3209) together with wire_test.py, compression_wire_test.py, chown_wire_test.py and filter_wire_test.py. The sandbox denies the benchmarks/lab path, so I built the same parent C++ source into rs/target/cpp-build and used that as XS_BIN. The first interop run exposed that the test HELLO had to negotiate ZSTD and XATTR_STREAM; after that the C++ server accepted all configuration frames in order.
agent.change: Added rs/xs-wire/src/config.rs with typed Config variants for all configuration frames, files-data/end helpers, frame-type and feature mapping, C++ size/count limits, and unnegotiated-feature refusal. Added byte-pinned unit tests, malformed-frame tests, and an interop test that sends the whole negotiated sequence to the C++ xs --server and expects F_DEST. Exported the module from lib.rs.
agent.expected_effect: xs-wire can now write and read the complete configuration exchange that follows HELLO, so a C++ client can push to or pull from an xs-rs peer without the C++ side rejecting the configuration stage.
agent.risks: Filter rule grammar and compression suffix character-class semantics are only structurally validated here; full rule/suffix semantics belong to the later filter and compression steps. Interop was proven against a locally built copy of the same parent source rather than the lab's prebuilt XS_BIN, which the gate will use.
agent.tests: Without XS_BIN: 13 unit tests pass. With XS_BIN pointing at a locally built parent xs: 13 unit tests and 4 interop tests pass. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings is clean. cargo fmt --check is clean. Net change is 397 lines under rs/.
